notes.title: The 4th of August Update
notes.notes:
This time I tried to diversify the environment and add atmosphere to the game.

Changes in the update:

Updated graphics in the store
‌Added 2 levels
‌Added level selection in the pause menu
‌Added music to new levels
‌Fixed a bug in the tutorial, due to which the elements fell under the table during assembly


Write in the comments which locations you want to see in the game.

P. S. How do you feel about transferring the game to Free To Play with the mechanics of earning game coins and gradually opening content? In the current model, in every update, I open all the content at once, constantly increasing the value of the game.

Best Regards,
Fenix

notes.title: May 25th update - Tutorial
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37306204/f33a0e170bd94c2368b056cd4bfc2b55f460889f.png

A little over a month has passed since the release of the game. During this time I tried to take into account most of the wishes of the players and sincerely worked on the project.

May update changes:


 Tutorial at the start
 Saving the passage of the tutorial on SteamCloud
 ‌Changing flat puzzle pieces to volumetric
 Adding a table
 Fix blur in tooltips
 ‌Fix camera zoom with mouse wheel
 Adding a box with an example of the collected image
 The intangibility of the box when moving for convenience
 Cardboard box for 3 states (horizontal, vertical and square puzzle)
 Removed wall with sample image
 Element height increased from 30 to 70
 Improved translation of the game into 3 languages
 ‌New algorithm for generating pieces based on where the box appeared on the table
 ‌Adaptation of the generation algorithm to the table surface
 ‌Size of pieces reduced to 0.7 from the initial
 Reduced the generated number of elements in a square puzzle (4, 16, 36, 64, 100 instead of 9, 36, 81, 144, 225)
 Transfer control helper in the pause menu in a separate window
 Removed "?" from interface
 ‌Optimize pause interface
 ‌New style of pressing language selection buttons
 Renamed project system files to more relevant


It turned out to do a lot of work and I think that the game from this has become much better! Doing what you want to play yourself is a real pleasure)))

I hope you share my feelings! ^ _ ^

Fenix

notes.title: Game Release Update - BIG CHECK
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37306204/02f4f77f35187d5431ca57e119902c4966011494.png

In the release update:


 Change of language on the fly
 Stroke in red to make elements easier to find
 New algorithm for tracking the correct assembly of the puzzle
 Selection amount of solving pieces from 6 to 150 and 225 in square) The selection is implemented for 3 types of puzzles - horizontal, vertical and square
 New images in random libraries available at game start
 New algorithm for randomly generating pieces positions at the start. Now it looks more realistic
 A small bug fix with finding a neighboring element in the 0 line


I hope you will enjoy! I tried very hard ^_^
